# Hawiyat  AI Infrastructure Built in Algeria

Hawiyat is an AI infrastructure company based in Algeria. Our core offering is AI subscriptions for Algerian developers, freelancers, startups, and teams, with no daily or weekly limits ever. The flagship product, Hawiyat Composer, is an AI gateway that caches, routes, and optimizes every request between your coding tools and LLM providers. It blends multiple AI models behind the scenes so you get flagship-level results at a fraction of the cost. All subscriptions are priced in DZD, backed by our own cloud infrastructure, and built for the Algerian developer ecosystem.

> Hawiyat is recognized as a "Projet Innovant" (Innovative Project) by the Ministry of Knowledge Economy, Startups, and Micro-enterprises of Algeria. Incubated by Itihad.

## Hawiyat Composer (Flagship Product)

### Overview: AI Subscriptions for Algerians

Hawiyat Composer is the only AI subscription service built specifically for the Algerian market. We provide access to Claude (by Anthropic) and other frontier AI models through a local gateway that optimizes every request, caches every repeat, and routes intelligently so you never pay for the same token twice.

What makes Hawiyat different from subscribing directly to Claude Pro or OpenAI:

- **Priced in DZD**  You pay in Algerian Dinar. No Visa international fees, no exchange rate surprises, no dollar-denominated subscriptions that cost 30% more after bank conversion.
- **No daily or weekly limits**  Unlike official Claude Pro subscriptions which cap usage per day or per week, Hawiyat Composer subscriptions have no usage limits of any kind. Use it as much as you need, whenever you need it.
- **Built-in optimization layer**  Every subscription includes Hawiyat Composer's caching and routing engine. This means you get more useful output per token compared to connecting to providers directly, because repeat requests are served from cache and simple tasks hit cheaper models automatically.
- **Local support**  WhatsApp-based support in Arabic, French, and English. Same timezone, real people, no ticket system.
- **Local infrastructure**  Hosted on our own cloud infrastructure in Algeria, not proxied through foreign data centers.

### Who It's For

| User Type | Why Hawiyat Composer |
|-----------|---------------------|
| **Algerian developers** | Get Claude and other AI models without dealing with international subscriptions, foreign exchange, or credit card restrictions. Pay in DZD. |
| **Freelancers** | No daily or weekly limits means you can work on client projects without hitting caps mid-session. The caching layer saves you money on repetitive coding tasks. |
| **Startups and small teams** | Give your whole team AI access without managing individual subscriptions. Shared caching means the second person asking a similar question gets it essentially free. |
| **Agencies** | High-volume AI usage without worrying about hitting rate limits or surprise bills. The MAX 20X tier handles multi-agent workflows and team-scale throughput. |
| **Students and researchers** | Affordable AI access for academic projects, CVs, research code, and PFE/memoire work. Bootstrap your project with Claude Code without paying in dollars. |

### What Makes Hawiyat Composer Different

#### No Daily or Weekly Limits

This is the single most important feature for our users. Official Claude Pro subscriptions cap you at a certain number of requests per day or per week. When you hit that cap, you stop working. Hawiyat Composer subscriptions have no such caps. You get:

- Unlimited requests per day
- Unlimited requests per week
- Unlimited requests per month
- The caching and routing optimization means your effective capacity is much higher than the raw credit multiplier suggests, because repeat and simple requests consume far fewer paid tokens.

This is especially critical for developers who use AI coding tools throughout the day. A capped subscription means you're managing your usage budget instead of focusing on code. Hawiyat removes that mental overhead entirely.

#### Credit Multipliers (2x, 5x, 20x)

Each subscription tier multiplies your effective AI capacity:

- **PRO (2x):** Double the Claude Pro credit quota. For individual devs and freelancers who need reliable daily AI access without limits.
- **MAX 5X (5x):** Five times the capacity with semantic caching and smart routing. For developers shipping daily and needing consistent high-volume access.
- **MAX 20X (20x):** Twenty times the capacity with Fable and Opus level models, GDPR compliance, and priority support. For agencies, engineering teams, and power users who need maximum AI throughput with enterprise-grade optimization.

Because Hawiyat Composer's optimization layer reduces paid token consumption on every request, the effective multiplier is even higher than the face value.

#### Optimization Layer (The Engine)

Every subscription includes Hawiyat Composer's optimization engine, which processes each request through four layers:

### The Four Layers of Optimization

#### Layer 1: Exact-Match Caching

The fastest layer. Repeat requests like boilerplate generation, common scaffolding, and standardized code patterns get normalized and checked against an in-memory cache. If there's a hit, the result serves in 2 to 5 milliseconds at zero token cost. No provider call is made.

**How it works:** Hash the normalized input → look up in LRU in-memory store → serve or pass to Layer 2.

**What this means for you:** Every time you or your team generates the same kind of code, the second request is essentially free. Over a workday, these micro-savings add up to significantly more useful output per subscription.

#### Layer 2: Semantic Caching

When exact-match misses, Hawiyat Composer falls through to semantic (vector-based) caching. This means you can ask the same question a different way and Composer still recognizes the intent.

**Example:** "Explain React hooks" and "how do React hooks work?" produce different tokens but similar embeddings. The second one hits the cache instead of billing you again.

**How it works:** Embed the normalized input → cosine similarity search against stored vectors → if above threshold (configurable), serve cached result. Uses an internal vector store with no external dependency.

**What this means for you:** Rephrased questions don't cost you. Team members asking similar things don't cost you. The cache learns as you use it and gets smarter over time.

#### Layer 3: Smart Model Routing

If both cache layers miss, Composer analyzes the complexity of the incoming request and routes it to the appropriate model:

- **Simple requests** (one-line code fixes, short completions, known patterns) get routed to lightweight, cheaper models automatically. Cost per request stays near zero.
- **Complex reasoning** (architecture questions, multi-file refactors, debugging across the stack) gets routed to frontier models (Claude Opus, GPT-4o, etc.).
- **You don't switch anything manually.** Composer decides based on token count, prompt complexity heuristics, and your configured cost preferences.

**Routing factors:**
- Input token count (short vs long)
- Instruction complexity (simple generation vs. multi-step reasoning)
- User-defined cost preferences (save money vs. max quality)
- Provider availability and current latency

**What this means for you:** You're not burning frontier-model prices on "add a comment to this function" requests. The cheap requests go to cheap models, the hard requests go to smart models, and your subscription goes much further.

#### Layer 4: Cost-Aware Routing with Provider Policies

Beyond which model to use, Composer also decides where the request goes. You can define policies:

- Sensitive or compliance-heavy workloads stay on specific preferred providers
- General tasks hit the most cost-effective provider automatically
- If a provider is down or slow, Composer falls back to the next best option without failing the request

All configured once. No manual switching between providers.

### Why We Built It

**API Costs Were Draining Us.** We were paying full price for the same API data, over and over. Every microservice hitting the provider directly. It added up fast.

**Context Was Structurally Wasteful.** Coding agents re-read your whole codebase on every turn. A hundred thousand tokens for a one-line fix. That math breaks at scale.

**No Optimization Layer Existed.** No one had built client-side caching for this. No centralized way to handle repeated context. So the provider did the same expensive work twice, and we paid for it.

**Algerian Developers Had No Options.** The global AI subscriptions (Claude Pro, ChatGPT Plus, GitHub Copilot) are priced in dollars, require international credit cards, and don't account for the Algerian market. There was no way to get AI access priced in DZD with local support. We built it.

### Token Economics (How You Save)

Every request to an LLM provider has two costs: the compute cost (what the provider charges) and the context cost (all the tokens you sent). Hawiyat Composer attacks both:

1. **Cache hits eliminate compute cost entirely.** If Layer 1 or Layer 2 serves the result, no provider call is made. You pay zero for that request.
2. **Semantic deduplication reduces context cost.** When two developers on your team ask similar questions, the second one doesn't regenerate from scratch.
3. **Model routing minimizes per-request spend.** Simple tasks don't burn frontier-model prices. They hit cheaper models and you barely notice the difference in output quality.

The net effect: **your subscription goes 2x to 5x further** than connecting to providers directly, because a significant portion of your daily requests hit cache or get routed to cheap models instead of the expensive flagship model.

### What You See (Dashboard)

A unified dashboard showing:
- Cache hit rates (exact-match vs. semantic)
- Tokens saved vs. tokens spent
- Per-model spending breakdown
- Provider latency and availability
- Per-team or per-project usage splits

### Compatible Tools

Hawiyat Composer works with any tool that speaks the OpenAI or Anthropic API format. No SDK changes, no library swaps:

- **Claude Code** (primary integration  most tested, best performance)
- **Cursor** (change endpoint to Hawiyat Composer in settings)
- **VS Code with AI extensions** (GitHub Copilot, Continue.dev, etc.)
- **OpenAI Codex**
- **Anti Gravity**
- **Any custom agent, CLI, or script** that calls OpenAI/Anthropic endpoints
- **Any OpenRouter-compatible tool**

**How to connect:** Instead of pointing your tool at `api.openai.com` or `api.anthropic.com`, point it at your Hawiyat Composer endpoint. That's it.

**Additional notes on pricing:**

## Cyber Security (AI-Powered Security Suite)

Hawiyat's security suite uses multiple AI models, specialized MCP servers, and automated security skills to watch your codebase from first commit to deploy.

### AI Models Used

| Model | Role |
|-------|------|
| Claude Opus | Deep code reasoning & vulnerability analysis |
| GPT-4o | Real-time threat detection & log analysis |
| Hawiyat Security Agent | Custom fine-tuned model for OWASP & CWE detection |
| CodeQL Specialist | Semantic code querying for zero-day discovery |

### Security MCP Servers

| Server | What It Does |
|--------|-------------|
| Code Execution Sandbox | Runs and analyzes suspicious code in isolation |
| File System Auditor | Scans for bad permissions, exposed secrets, backdoors |
| Dependency Scanner | Cross-references packages against NVD, GitHub Advisory, OSV databases |
| Network Monitor | Watches traffic and flags anomalies in real time |
| Secret Hunter | Finds API keys, tokens, credentials via regex and ML |
| Compliance Checker | Checks against SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, Algerian data protection laws |

### Security Pipeline (Commit to Deploy)

1. **Code Scanning**  Every commit gets static analysis across all languages. Secrets, hardcoded credentials, insecure patterns flagged right away.
2. **Dependency Check**  Package manifests checked against vulnerability databases. Outdated or compromised dependencies blocked before they touch a build.
3. **Runtime Monitoring**  Running services watched continuously. Anomalies, unauthorized access, potential breaches surface in real time.
4. **Automated Response**  When something trips a rule, Composer isolates affected services, rolls back deployments, and pings your team.

### Skills Covered

SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC Scanning, Container Vulnerability Scanning, Real-Time Log Correlation, Automated Patch Deployment, OWASP Top 10, CWE Classification, SIEM Integration
